name: Restrained Dialogue Glance & Micro-Nod
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep human acting subtle and believable: `she listens calmly, blinks once, shifts gaze slightly toward rain-streaked glass, and gives an almost imperceptible resolute nod`—avoid exaggerated rubbery mouth flap.

name: Shadow-to-Rimlight Dramatic Turn
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stage beat cleanly: `backlit figure stands motionless looking out window. Slowly they turn their head 90 degrees over shoulder as crisp warm amber side-light catches cheekbones and eyes`.

name: Drenched Cloak Hood Pull-Back Intro
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Choreograph weighted hand action: `gloved right hand reaches calmly upward and pulls heavy rain-soaked dark wool hood backward off hair, droplets scattering onto lit shoulders`.

name: Controlled Iaido Blade Unsheathe
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Split into crisp beats: `thumb nudges brass tsuba unlocking scabbard silently. Steel blade glides steadily forward catching narrow moonlight streak right before snapping into low ready stance`.

name: Kinetic Strike, Recoil & Mist Spray
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Emphasize real physics on impact: `hook lands cleanly forcing sharp head whip and fine backlit sweat/dust spray bursting outward into dark arena spotlights as shoulders coil back`.

name: Rooftop Vault Weight Transfer
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Track momentum cleanly: `runner plants left palm atop concrete ledge, swings legs cleanly overhead clearing gap, and absorbs concrete landing dynamically into rolling forward sprint`.

name: Silk Dress Spin & Secondary Follow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Match rotational inertia cleanly: `dancer spots gaze crisply forward while spinning cleanly, crimson silk skirt flaring outward in delayed wave around ankles across sunlit stage floor dust`.

name: Thundering Gallop Dust Track Parallel
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Truck parallel beside `dark bay stallion galloping furiously across golden prairie scrub, hooves kicking backlit dust clods upward while rider leans smoothly over whipping mane`.

name: Motorcycle Lean Through Mountain Switchback
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep gyroscopic stability plausible: `matte black sportbike leans deeply left hugging painted alpine hairpin curve, visor catching dawn peaks while blurred road markings streak beneath knee`.

name: Passenger Platform Departure Drift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Contrast stationary traveler on wet brick platform against accelerating brass-trimmed green train carriages gliding right, window lamps painting streaks through misty evening air.

name: Late-Night Diner Coffee Pour
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor hands steady over ceramic cup: `waitress tilts glass carafe smoothly pouring dark glossy coffee into thick ivory diner mug while bright warm steam curls under neon sign window`.

name: Orbital Deceleration & Hull Glint
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Blend scale and crisp solar light: `massive angular Titanium cruiser glides majestically past camera over curved blue planetary cloud limb as tiny docking tug beacons pulse rhythmically`.

name: Iron Knight Walking Through Forge Embers
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Ground metallic heaviness: `tall scarred knight in rain-streaked hammered plate strides steadily down broken stone steps, tattered cape dragging while bright hearth embers swirl past steel pauldrons`.

name: Neon Umbrella Water Flick & Step
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Give clear tactile beat: `traveler pauses beneath glowing neon awning. She shakes tilted translucent umbrella firmly twice spraying crisp cyan-lit water arcs onto wet street`.

name: Continuous Macro Portal Zoom Transition
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive unbroken forward dive: `camera pushes seamlessly inside dark pupil reflection/fabric weave pores, transitioning smoothly through glowing geometric fibers into vast illuminated valley horizon`.

name: Seamless Circular Geometry Match Cut
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Align identical screen-space circle center: `spinning brass pocket watch hands blur rapidly as circular rim transforms seamlessly into glowing golden tunnel entrance rotating forward`.

name: Orbital Cloud-Drop Hyper-Zoom
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prompt continuous vertical dive: `fast unobstructed aerial drop plunging steeply downward straight through luminous golden cloud deck toward winding glowing river and mountain town roofs`.

name: In-Shot Glass Raindrop Rack-Focus Reveal
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep lens locked steady: `extreme close focus holds on backlit amber raindrops clinging to dark window glass. Focus pulls smoothly deep backward sharpening lone silhouetted figure on street`.

name: Horizontal Swish-Blur Scene Pivot
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use horizontal speed bridge cleanly: `calm snowy forest pan accelerates explosively right into seamless motion blur streaking amber-ward, decelerating crisply onto warm firelit cabin table`.

name: Moving Vehicle / Crowd Reveal Wipe
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use organic foreground blocker cleanly: `blurred dark tram car sweeps horizontally right across frame momentarily blacking lens, clearing smoothly onto sunlit coastal square beyond`.

name: Feature-Film Sakuga Cel Fluidity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `theatrical high-framerate 24fps anime cel animation, painted watercolor clouds, expressive smear frames strictly on rapid dash limbs, glowing hand-drawn impact sparks`.

name: Monochrome Noir Rain & Trenchcoat Walk
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Render high-contrast `1940s monochrome cinema footage`: solitary trenchcoated silhouette steps out of fog-choked alley past one hard overhead streetlamp casting razor shadows down wet cobbles.

name: Grounded Verité Action Tracking
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `low shoulder-rig documentary tracking`: harsh rotor/wind dust blowing furiously sideways across scuffed canvas gear while characters move purposefully past concrete barriers.

name: Editorial Slow-Mo Coat & Silk Flow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Shoot `75mm medium telephoto slow motion` tracking model striding sharply forward: heavy structured wool coat hem billows majestically behind against subtle flashed specular strobes.

name: Atmospheric Stillness & Passing World
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor emotional quiet cleanly: `calm figure sits motionless at wooden window table cradling warm tea cup while distant pine mist and soft falling rain move gently beyond clear glass`.
